scripts.deploy:contracts: cd contracts && set -a && . ../.env && set +a && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url $MONAD_TESTNET_RPC_URL --broadcast
scripts.contracts:abi: cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && node scripts/export-abi.mjs
